name: motion-number-upvotes

frames.best_why: The green upvote state is fully settled at 16, with both round arrow buttons and the count all clear.

tagline: An upvote card whose count rolls and flips green or red as you vote.
summary: A small rounded card showing an upvote total between two round arrow buttons. Clicking up or down rolls the number and tints the card and the chosen button green or red.
appearance: A compact rounded card with bold light text reading 14 Upvotes above two black circular buttons, one holding an up arrow and one a down arrow. It sits on black; pressing an arrow turns the card deep green or deep red.
behaviour: Pressing an arrow nudges the number up or down with a vertical rolling animation inside the total. The card background and the pressed button switch to green for up or red for down, and each button shrinks a little while held.
demo_content: The count starts at 14 and changes to 16 or 15 during the clip.
search_phrases: small card with up down arrows
use_when: A post, comment or feature needs a lightweight up and down vote control with an animated score.
avoid_when: It only changes local state with no undo or persistence, and the colours are fixed to green and red.
customise: The starting count and the green and red colours are hardcoded and it takes no props; wiring it to real data means editing the component.
weight_why: Two buttons and one number with a short spring; no canvas or loop.

a11y.note: Both arrow controls are icon-only with no aria-labels, so screen readers announce them as unlabelled buttons.

issues: The arrow buttons have no accessible labels, so their purpose is not announced.
Frames 3 and 5 catch the digits overlapping mid-roll, which reads as a glitch in a still.
polish_why: Readable count and clear green and red feedback, but the layout and styling are plain.
